item.gitanoland.kirky_bag.help: Right-click: store all Kirkys. Shift + right-click: take out a stack.
gitanoland.shop.fail: You don't have what it takes.
gitanoland.shop.levelup: Level up: %s! Reopen the shop to see new items.
gitanoland.shop.missing: [GitanoLand] %s offers could not be resolved (see log; /gitanoland tacz_ids).
effect.smokeleafindustries.stoned.descri: The universal high. Comes from smoking (Joint, Blunt, Bong, Dab Rig) or eating edibles. Its screen effect gets stronger with the THC of the strain; high CBD makes it shorter.
effect.smokeleafindustries.sleepy.descri: Makes you sway sideways as you walk, like you're drunk, and slows you down.
effect.smokeleafindustries.euphoric.desc: Forces you to sprint and slightly reduces hunger drain while it lasts.
effect.smokeleafindustries.uplifted.desc: Gives your steps a spring: extra horizontal momentum and a jump-boost feel.
effect.smokeleafindustries.chillout.desc: A calming effect that also pacifies nearby zombies.
effect.smokeleafindustries.scrambled_mou: Garbles what you say in chat.
effect.smokeleafindustries.dry_mouth.des: Mirrors vanilla Nausea on your screen for as long as it lasts.
effect.smokeleafindustries.dizzy.descrip: Mirrors vanilla Confusion on your screen for as long as it lasts.
effect.smokeleafindustries.dry_eyes.desc: Tints your vision with a reddened haze.
effect.smokeleafindustries.aroused.descr: Pulls nearby animals and villagers toward you.
effect.smokeleafindustries.high_flyer.de: Grants Creative-style flight for as long as it lasts.
effect.smokeleafindustries.sticky_icky.d: Magnetically pulls nearby dropped items and XP orbs toward you.
effect.smokeleafindustries.paranoia.desc: Randomly spawns fake spooky sounds and hallucinated mobs that aren't really there.
effect.smokeleafindustries.zombified.des: Standing in direct sunlight without a helmet sets you on fire (or damages your helmet), like a zombie.
effect.smokeleafindustries.r_trees.descr: Signature effect of the Jack Herer strain.
effect.smokeleafindustries.vein_high.des: Signature effect of the Carbon Fiber strain.
effect.smokeleafindustries.rainbow.descr: A mostly visual effect that flavors a strain's high.
effect.smokeleafindustries.breathing.des: A mostly atmospheric effect that flavors a strain's high.
effect.smokeleafindustries.bubbled.descr: A mostly visual effect that flavors a strain's high.
effect.smokeleafindustries.melted.descri: A mostly visual effect that flavors a strain's high.
